```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure ILIKE '%nature reserve%'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name = 'Monongalia County' AND border_type = 'county'))
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve))
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE leisure ILIKE '%nature reserve%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve))) AS reserve_name,
  MAX((ST_Value(rast, 1))::numeric) AS max_elevation
FROM clipped_dem;
```
